title: Inter-Unit Domain Relationship Schema
description: How an organization unit relates to a domain entity: owning, providing, consuming, governing and other roles. Inter-unit relationships connect organization units within one domain; for links between domains, see cross-domain-relationship.schema.json.

relationshipID.description: Unique identifier for the inter-unit domain relationship

domainType.description: The domain of the entity. Inter-unit relationships focus on capability, information, service, valueStream, initiative or product.

entityID.description: ID of the domain entity (see entityName)

relationshipRole.description: The organization unit's role in relation to the entity

oneOf.description: Accountable for the entity's governance, lifecycle and quality; one owning unit per entity
Delivers the entity's core functionality, service or resource
Actively uses the entity's outputs or results to perform its own operations
Provides partial input, expertise or resources without being the primary provider
Benefits from the entity, even indirectly, without consuming or operating it
Maintains the integrity, accuracy and compliance of an information or data entity
Relies on the effective functioning of another unit's entity to achieve its objectives
Gives operational advantage or risk reduction to another unit's activity
Sets rules, standards or oversight mechanisms for the entity
Tracks the entity's performance, usage or compliance without operational involvement
Validates, approves or signs off the entity's outputs or changes
Facilitates collaboration between the units involved with the entity
Provides advisory input or specialist knowledge without operational responsibility
Receives escalated issues, exceptions or decisions about the entity
(value streams only) Contributes to specific stages of the value stream
(value streams only) Initiates or activates value stream execution
(initiatives only) Provides funding, executive support or strategic backing
(initiatives only) Its operations, processes or outcomes are affected by the initiative

orgUnitTitle.description: Name of the organization unit holding the role

orgUnitID.description: ID of the organization unit (see orgUnitTitle)

relationshipDescription.description: How the unit is involved with the entity

relationshipStrength.description: Intensity of the relationship: 1 very weak, 3 moderate, 5 very strong (mission-critical)

allOf.description: Identify the entity by name or ID
Identify the organization unit by name or ID
participating and triggering apply only to value streams
sponsoring and impactedBy apply only to initiatives
